subject.title: fix(sandbox): bound Docker exec with a deadline so a wedged engine can't hang the gateway

question: Should Docker sandbox initialization expose `agents.defaults.sandbox.docker.initTimeoutMs` as a user-facing compatibility setting, or should the fix use an internal bounded deadline until a supported configuration contract is approved?
rationale: The bug warrants a bounded failure path, but adding a persistent public sandbox setting changes the supported upgrade and operator contract beyond the mechanical timeout repair.

options.title: Use an internal bounded deadline
options.body: Fix the hang with a maintained internal default and avoid expanding the already compatibility-sensitive sandbox configuration surface.

options.title: Approve a public timeout setting
options.body: Keep `initTimeoutMs`, but document fresh-install and upgrade behavior and add focused validation for slow yet healthy Docker engines.

recommendation.title: Use an internal bounded deadline
recommendation.body: Fix the hang with a maintained internal default and avoid expanding the already compatibility-sensitive sandbox configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main sandbox ownership could not be attributed reliably from the accessible review material.
